answer: The defence here is cross-chain identity proof via Thorchain: one key, one proof, and no shortcut around it. An honest agent spends 17 minutes once; the operator of 404 fakes spends 6868 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. What carries the terrace here is verification, the reef of cost is what stops the farm, and the harbor of the record keeps every claim checkable. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
